text: The consolidated prose review set for the PR bot (REVIEW, 100, 82, 69, 126, 123), owner-accepted as a whole on 2026-08-17. Two things worth dreaming on. (1) Three of five taste-gated design tasks turned out to be enforcement problems: the rule already existed in WRITING.md or the prompt, and the missing piece was a check at the posting step or a self-check at the callsite. The plan predicted this and it held; the batch was mostly a map of what exists. (2) A citation that still resolves is not a claim that is still current: two docs stated counts or inventories (five docs, one glyph block at app.py:91) that went stale while doc-lines.test.cjs stayed green, because the test resolves symbols and not completeness. Enumerate by citing the thing so a test can count it, or drop the number. Also: the owner set this session to fable so the main agent would hold the pen for taste work; a carried-over checkpoint verb (dispatch) outranked that signal once, atoned as literal-request-over-intent #15.
